headline: METR says public data isn't enough to rule out a drastic acceleration in AI research
body: According to the AI research organization METR, current public data isn't enough to rule out a drastic acceleration in AI research over the next few years. The organization also warns that common, easy-to-run tests may overestimate how well models perform in real-world use.
note: For banks and insurers, that gap matters when a model's test results are the main basis for deploying it. METR's warning suggests those results may read higher than daily use will.
